values.title: Discount Codes
user_stories: As a shopper, I want to enter a discount code on the checkout page, so that I pay less for my order.
As a shopper, I want to see the discount and the new total before I place my order, so that I know exactly what I will pay.
As a shopper, I want a clear error when my code cannot be used, so that I understand why my total did not change.
As a store owner, I want the codes SAVE10, WELCOME20 and SUMMER15 available with their rules, so that I can run promotions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cart totalling $30.00, When the shopper applies SAVE10 at checkout, Then the checkout shows a $3.00 discount and a total of $27.00.
Given a cart with any total, When the shopper applies the code as 'save10' or 'Save10', Then it is accepted the same as SAVE10.
Given a cart totalling $50.00 or more, When the shopper applies WELCOME20, Then 20% is taken off and the total is shown reduced.
Given a cart totalling less than $50.00, When the shopper applies WELCOME20, Then an error saying the order is below the code's $50.00 minimum is shown and the total is unchanged.
Given any cart, When the shopper applies SUMMER15, Then an error saying the code has expired is shown and the total is unchanged.
Given any cart, When the shopper applies a code that does not exist (e.g. BOGUS), Then an error saying the code is invalid is shown and the total is unchanged.
Given a cart totalling $19.99, When the shopper applies SAVE10, Then the discount is $2.00 (rounded to the nearest cent) and the total is $17.99.
Given a valid code has been applied, When the shopper places the order, Then the order confirmation and the stored order total show the discounted total.
out_of_scope: Admin screens for creating, editing or deleting discount codes
Applying more than one code to the same order (stacking)
Fixed-amount discounts, free shipping or product-specific codes
Per-shopper or total usage limits on codes
Showing discount codes on the cart page or product pages
Emailing receipts that show the discount

api_contract.description: Checks a discount code against the current session cart and returns the discount and the new total. It changes nothing. The code is normalised with strip().upper(). Checks run in this order: unknown code, then expired (expires_at is set and is before the current naive UTC time), then minimum (cart total_cents < min_subtotal_cents). Discount = (subtotal_cents * percent_off + 50) // 100, which rounds half up in integer maths. Total = subtotal_cents - discount_cents.
api_contract.request: Header X-Session-Id. Body {"code": str (min_length 1, max_length 32)}, e.g. {"code": "save10"}
status_codes: 400 {"detail": "Order total is below the $50.00 minimum for this code"} (the amount comes from formatting min_subtotal_cents as $X.XX)

api_contract.description: Changed: accepts an optional discount_code. If the code is present and not blank, the server runs the same shared helper against the current cart before any stock change. On error it returns 400 with the same detail, creates no order and leaves the cart and stock unchanged. On success it stores discount_code (normalised), discount_cents, and total_cents = subtotal - discount. A missing, null or blank code behaves exactly as before.
api_contract.request: Header X-Session-Id. Body {"customer_name": str, "email": str, "address": str, "discount_code": str | null (optional, max_length 32)}
status_codes: 400 {"detail": "Order total is below the $50.00 minimum for this code"}

Adds discount_code and discount_cents to orders. total_cents still means the amount paid, which is the discounted total.

review.summary: Clean, focused change. The shared calculate_discount helper does the checks in the contract order (unknown, then expired, then minimum) and uses the contract's integer half-up rounding. All lookups go through the ORM, so there is no SQL injection risk. The cart comes from the X-Session-Id header, so one shopper's session cannot leak into another's. When placing an order, the code is checked before any stock change, so on error no order is created and the cart and stock are untouched. The response shapes, the schema validation (code length 1-32; discount_code optional, max 32) and the error messages all match the contract. Tests cover every acceptance criterion at the API, UI and E2E levels, including rounding ($19.99 -> $2.00), case-insensitive codes, and the stored order total.

findings.finding: The applied discount is a one-time preview. If the cart changed after Apply (e.g. in another tab), the shown total could be stale. The server recalculates when the order is placed, so the stored total is always correct; this is display-only.

calculate_discount is a shared helper kept in a routes module and imported by orders.py. This matches the existing pattern of importing helpers from routes.cart. A service module could be considered later.

The migration matches the model: unique index on code, percent check constraint, and server_default 0 for discount_cents so existing orders stay valid. Downgrade uses batch_alter_table, which SQLite needs.

values.release_notes: Corner Shop 1.2.0 (2026-10-18) adds Discount Codes (REQ-002). Shoppers can now enter a discount code at checkout. Codes are not case-sensitive. Before placing the order, shoppers see the subtotal, the discount and the new total. If a code can't be used, they get a clear message saying whether the code is unknown, expired or below its minimum order amount, and the total stays the same. When the order is placed, it saves the code, the discount and the discounted total, and the confirmation page shows the discounted total. Three codes come with the store: SAVE10, WELCOME20 (needs a minimum order amount) and SUMMER15 (expired). For developers: there is a new endpoint, POST /api/discounts/apply. POST /api/orders now accepts an optional discount_code and checks it before any stock changes. A new discount_codes table and two new columns on orders (discount_code, discount_cents) come with a new Alembic migration. All 67 API tests, 19 unit tests and 6 end-to-end tests pass.
highlights: Shoppers can apply a discount code at checkout (not case-sensitive)
Checkout shows the subtotal, the discount and the new total before the order is placed
Clear errors for unknown codes, expired codes or orders below the minimum. The total stays the same
Orders save the code, the discount and the discounted total. The confirmation shows the discounted total
New codes: SAVE10, WELCOME20 (has a minimum order) and SUMMER15 (expired)
New endpoint POST /api/discounts/apply. POST /api/orders accepts an optional discount_code
